# netactuate_cloud_floating_ips (Data Source)

Reads Cloud Floating Ips visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_floating_ips" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `floating_ips` (List of Object) List of account-level cloud floating IPv4 addresses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--floating_ips))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--floating_ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `floating_ips`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `assigned_on` (String)
- `floating_ipv4_id` (Number)
- `location` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedobjatt--floating_ips--location))
- `ptr_domain` (String)
- `vlan_id` (Number)
